titleEs: Diablo 4 Dad vs Diablo4codex — los dos collection trackers
titleEn: Diablo 4 Dad vs Diablo4codex — the two collection trackers
descriptionEs: Ambos trackean progresión en D4 pero con scopes distintos. Codex foco en seasonal progress + Codex of Power; Dad foco en world collection (altars, statues, glyphs, mounts).
descriptionEn: Both track D4 progression but with different scopes. Codex focuses on seasonal progress + Codex of Power; Dad focuses on world collection (altars, statues, glyphs, mounts).
verdictEs: Diablo4codex para seasonal grind y Codex of Power. Diablo 4 Dad para world completion comprehensive (altars, statues, glyphs, mounts). Para ultra-completionists, ambos en sequence cubren todo.
verdictEn: Diablo4codex for seasonal grind and Codex of Power. Diablo 4 Dad for comprehensive world completion (altars, statues, glyphs, mounts). For ultra-completionists, both in sequence cover everything.

useCases.labelEs: Codex of Power aspects unlocked tracking
useCases.labelEn: Codex of Power aspects unlocked tracking
useCases.reasonEs: Diablo4codex es Codex of Power-first. Dad cubre otras collection metrics pero Codex específicamente es el strength de Diablo4codex.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo4codex is Codex of Power-first. Dad covers other collection metrics but Codex specifically is Diablo4codex's strength.

useCases.labelEs: Altars of Lilith y Renown progress
useCases.labelEn: Altars of Lilith and Renown progress
useCases.reasonEs: Dad cubre altars + Renown statues + per-region progress detail. Codex no granulariza Renown progress en mismo nivel.
useCases.reasonEn: Dad covers altars + Renown statues + per-region progress detail. Codex doesn't granularize Renown progress at the same level.

useCases.reasonEs: Dad trackea paragon glyphs collected vs total disponibles. Codex no incluye paragon glyphs como tracking metric.
useCases.reasonEn: Dad tracks paragon glyphs collected vs total available. Codex doesn't include paragon glyphs as a tracking metric.

useCases.reasonEs: Codex es seasonal-focused y trackea Journey objectives explicitly. Dad cubre menos seasonal mechanics.
useCases.reasonEn: Codex is seasonal-focused and tracks Journey objectives explicitly. Dad covers less of seasonal mechanics.

useCases.reasonEs: Dad incluye mount completion plus minor collectibles (emotes, etc.) que Codex no trackea como granularity prioritaria.
useCases.reasonEn: Dad includes mount completion plus minor collectibles (emotes, etc.) that Codex doesn't track as priority granularity.
